checked: Exact Hebrew and English words in emitted call order, normalized for NFC and formatting whitespace; paragraph and line boundaries carry explicit separators to prevent adjacent words from merging.

English presence and gaps remain unchanged, including the shared entrance, before-prayer, Yigdal and Barukh Shem providers.
Consecutive facsimiles are compressed per column and compared by physical Archive leaf. Medium/full JPG resolution variants identify the same page; different items and leaves stay distinct.
Expanded-night credits, licences and source bibliography are identical. Documentary whole-book colophons also remain identical after the morning addition.
Documentary comparison uses the prior Maariv subtree instead of requiring equality of the entire index after morning is appended.

raw_documentary103_review.method: Compared all 103 actual XML bodies with approved source fragments, choosing sic/abbr for printed readings and normalizing only NFC and formatting whitespace. Notes and ordinal labels stay outside prayer-word comparison. Source paragraph/poetic-line groups and all page labels and Archive leaves match.

current_documentary_compilation.method: Checked all 62 ordered source calls in each documentary Hebrew/parallel print/electronic artifact. Actual Hebrew, expected English, absent translations and source leaves match. Only the evidenced will/hast corrections and corrected removal of the source-only duplicate affect the default corrected reading.

remaining_separate_gates: Current PDF/HTML presentation: column geometry, notes, backlinks, bookmarks, readable conditional labels and click targets require the final export review.
Browser interaction for deferred electronic conditions and visual paragraphs belongs to final export QA. Electronic XML words and retained conditions were checked here.
Scan 46 is lookahead outside the present scan 25–45 acceptance scope.
